text:
alex: deploy-bot just flagged a problem during the traffic shift for payments-service. chart v2.4.0 promoted 3m ago, we're seeing ~5% 503s and sidecar probe timeouts. change window still open (~40m). :eyes:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary promotion started -> payments-service:v2.4.0
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Health: error-rate=5.1% over 2m, 503 spike, sidecar liveness failures. logs: https://dash.internal/redwood/payments/canary-1234
maya: seeing sidecar timeouts in traces, readiness probe failing around the same time as the postupgrade job finishes. stack trace looks like connection pool exhaustion.
maya: logs snippet:
```
kubectl logs payments-6b7f -c sidecar --tail=200
[2026-03-21T10:11:58Z] probe: ready check timed out after 5s
[2026-03-21T10:12:00Z] requests queueing: connPool=85/100
[2026-03-21T10:12:02Z] 503 GET /charge -> upstream timeout
```
aj: (typo in earlier name)

tj: change window ends in ~40m, but we probably shouldn't let this keep rolling. If rollback is quick we can re-promote later.
sam: can we hotpatch the sidecar probe timeout first? bump probe from 5s -> 10s in chart values and re-run canary?
carla: support will get alerted and start drafting release notes for the rollback path + incident summary.
alex: decision: manual rollback to last stable chart (2.3.9). pin current image and hold promotions until root cause triaged. I'll kick the rollback now. @deploy-bot please suspend auto-promotion for payments-service and run rollback. :hammer_and_wrench:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Suspension acknowledged by system. Auto-promotion suspended for payments-service by @alex. Starting rollback job -> RB-8421.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Running: `helm rollback payments-release 45 --namespace prod` (45 = previous release index)

sam: running the rollback command manually from a terminal in case the bot hits a lock:
```
helm rollback payments-release 45 --namespace prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/payments -w -n prod
```
maya: monitoring metrics now — traces page shows error-rate dropping in last 30s. :thumbsup:
tj: once rollback finishes, let's pin chart version in the release metadata so CI can't auto-promote v2.4.0 again. Add a follow-up ticket to the release notes.
carla: assembling the quick release notes: will include rollback timestamp, affected manifests, and the temporary pin. I'll paste notes in the RFC channel after we confirm rollback success.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback RB-8421 succeeded. Current release -> payments-service:v2.3.9. Health checks green. Canary traffic reverted.
alex: confirmed. Keeping promotions disabled until we merge a chart fix. Assigning sam + maya to fix probe defaults and run a preflight load test.
sam: will open a PR with chart bump to 2.4.1 that adjusts sidecar probe/readiness and reduces default connPool.
maya: +1, will add a smoke test in our canary harness to catch sidecar probe regressions.
tj: I'll update the release locks: `release-lock payments-service --pin 2.3.9` and add a note to the release playbook. command: `releasectl pin payments-service --version 2.3.9 --reason "post-canary 503 spike"`
carla: support notified, customers on team received an email about a brief service impact. I'll link the postmortem once done. :white_check_mark:
alex: great work. quick retrospective later.
